小雅家飾概念

讓居家空間，展現專屬的生活美學。

小雅家飾概念（Xiaoya.furniture） 是一家以窗簾為核心，提供多元居家裝飾服務的專業品牌，服務項目涵蓋窗簾、壁紙、地板及皮革等，致力於為每一個空間注入美感、質感與實用價值。
我們相信，理想的居家環境，不必在美感、功能與預算之間妥協。從空間風格、材質搭配到實際使用需求，我們以專業經驗與細心規劃，協助客戶找到合適的裝飾方案，讓每一項選擇都能兼顧美學與生活機能。
我們的合作對象涵蓋全台各地的室內設計師，以及重視居家品質與生活品味的個人客戶。無論是新居規劃、空間改造，或是局部裝飾更新，我們都希望透過合適的材質、細膩的搭配與合理的預算，打造兼具舒適、實用與美感的生活空間。
小雅家飾概念，從您的需求出發，讓每一個空間，都有自己的風格。

Xiaoya.furniture

Thoughtfully Designed Spaces. Beautifully Lived.

Xiaoya.furniture specializes in window treatments and a wide range of interior decorative solutions, including curtains, wallpaper, flooring, and leather finishes. We are dedicated to creating living spaces that balance aesthetics, functionality, and value.
We believe that a beautiful home should reflect the people who live in it. By understanding each client's needs, preferred style, practical requirements, and budget, we help bring together the right materials and design elements to create spaces that are both visually appealing and comfortable to live in.
We work with interior designers across Taiwan, as well as homeowners who appreciate quality, style, and thoughtful design. Whether it is a new home, a renovation, or a simple interior refresh, we provide tailored decorative solutions that bring harmony, practicality, and character to every space.
At Xiaoya.furniture, every great space begins with your needs and comes to life through thoughtful design.
